hero.kidsTitle: Let’s play and learn to speak clearly
hero.kidsSubtitle: Short exercises for R / L / SH sounds. A calm pace, gentle hints, and support — fun for the child, and progress you can see.
hero.parentSub: Play-based exercises for R / L / SH sounds: short sessions, gentle hints, and clear progress.
hero.forParentsText: Assessment in 15–20 minutes. Recommendations and a practice plan.

game.title: Sound Pop — mini-game
game.subtitle: Try speaking loudly or clapping — the game reacts to sound. We don’t recognize speech and we don’t save audio.

kids.parentsHintText: To see the method, safety, and book an assessment — hold the mode button at the top or tap the screen with two fingers.

parents.title: For parents
parents.subtitle: We’ll show the method, safety, and how your child will practice. Fast contact — via WhatsApp.
parents.safetyNote: Support instead of grades and comparisons. Privacy — by default.
parents.card1Text: Short sessions, gradual progression, gentle hints.
parents.card2Text: Your child’s data is under parents’ control. No hidden recordings.
parents.card3Text: A daily habit at a calm pace, without overload.
parents.card4Text: Clear steps and small wins you can see.
parents.bottomText: Message us on WhatsApp or watch exercises on TikTok.
parents.disclaimer: Prototype. Links lead to official social pages — we’ll connect your accounts later.

seo.title: Til Up — a speech therapy game for kids 3–9
seo.description: Play-based exercises for R/L/SH sounds: short sessions, gentle hints, privacy, and a clear assessment for parents.
